ordinary_contract.storage: Genuine passed live storage in one readable allocation through its first NUL at offset L; NUL-inclusive count L+1 and 32-bit extent do not wrap; arguments and storage stay stable. Stable readable aliases admitted; successful pointer borrows the same allocation.
ordinary_contract.character: Every MSVC Win32 int is admitted; unsigned-byte conversion after the forward pass selects low eight bits.
ordinary_contract.read_schedule: Read BYTEs 0..L ascending including NUL; convert target; read BYTEs L..first backward match or zero descending; unconditionally reread that reached match/base BYTE before returning.
ordinary_contract.result: Genuine pointer to highest matching offset, including first NUL when target low byte is zero; null when absent.
ordinary_contract.source_safety: Volatile unsigned-byte payload view retains Source reads; bounded unsigned 32-bit offset/count state never forms a before-begin pointer, including empty strings. No word overread or read beyond NUL.
ordinary_contract.native_abi_evidence: Pointer DWORD at EBP+8 loaded before first scan; target BYTE at EBP+12 later; entry DF=0 and flat ES; STD before backward scan; both normal outcomes join CLD; EDI/EBP restored; raw EAX pointer/zero and plain RET/caller cleanup.
ordinary_contract.excluded_protocols: Invalid/null/unterminated/dangling/inaccessible/wrapping storage, mutation, faults, concurrency and volatile/MMIO protocols; no new guard or recovery.
